notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938141/21d6a6c9c068d6d9429b096fc2f436dcc73f03fd.png[/img]

Hello Knights.

For this build we have been busy forging a brand new "Tight Mode" - a parallel for the Story Mode which provides an modified gameplay set-up; reducing run times, affording more replayability, and generally providing a more streamlined experienced.

Also present in the much requested ability to sell weapons and equipment at Blacksmith's. Hopefully this will tidy up your inventories later in the game as well as providing a little bit of extra spending money.

We've also made a bunch of changes that bring some behaviours in the game more in-line with your experiences within Fights in Tight Spaces, some adjustments to enemy AI, and more clarity in the status system.

Full build notes are below, and - as always - please let us know in the comments, on the discussion boards or on the Games In Tight Spaces Discord what you think of it!

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Tight Mode[/b] - a brand new alternative Story mode designed for a shorter playthroughs. Play through a shortened version of each Quest and - once you are ready - skip ahead to a final multi-fight stronghold. Tight Mode shares a save slot with your regular Story progress, so be sure to finish your current run before starting a new run in this mode.
[*] [b]Sell Equipment[/b] - as requested by many players, you can now sell unused equipment and consumables at Blacksmith to earn back 15% of their original value
[/list]

[h2]Major Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] The status system has been refined to work more in-line with player expectation.
[*] Additional status icons on overhead panels to quickly identify characters with Weakened, Vulnerable, and Pinned
[*] Statuses added by enemies during their Utility phase correctly continue through to the end of the turn rather than being removed prematurely
[*] Status effects applied during the enemy action phase (either by enemies or by the player via counters, etc.) now continue through to the end of the next turn to ensure they have an impact in all phases of the game
[*] Players now take damage from damage-over-time effects (i.e. poison and block) at the start of their own turn rather than the start of the enemy turn
[*] Pinned is removed from enemies AFTER their movement phase
[*] Improved text display for some status types
[*] Aggravated behaviour changes: Enemies that have Aggravated applied now immediately turn to face as well as continuing to target their Aggro target. This makes Tank characters more viable in Party Play.
[*] Randomly generated levels in Tight Mode, Daily Play, and Endless mode can use of a greater range of secondary objectives and rewards
[*] Randomly generated levels also give a small gold reward on completion
[/list]

[h2]Minor Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] New help screens for Aggravated and Strongholds
[*] Map screen now shows when a particular fight location contains a Protect or Survival objective
[/list]

[h2]AI Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Enemies who teleport pick their movement target more sensibly
[*] Enemies with Indirect attacks move more sensibly and consistently
[*] Indirect attackers will maintain their target when they move
[/list]

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Increased damage for Taunting Strike
[*] Fix for spawning isue where some levels were getting additional spawns on turn 1 and no spawns later in the fight (which made "prevent spawn" objectives much harder)
[*] Skeleton Mages now advance only once per turn
[*] Enemies will no longer actively move from tiles adjacent to voids if they already have a valid target (bringing the behaviour in line with FITS)
[*] Made Demon bosses slightly less of a difficulty spike, but made destruction of their related pillars more important!
[*] Conversely the Spymaster is now a little tougher to beat
[*] Flip now maintains combo with movement
[*] Fix for Firebomb to be usable by attuned characters only (as designed)
[*] Reduce cost and duration for Strike Fear card
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938141/b87675a979ebe615d88270efc0e53a2721b82aeb.png[/img]

Howdy Knights! Here are this week's patch notes:

[h2]Warlock Improvements[/h2]

We've updated everyone's favourite dark wizard to make play a little less random (although it's still one of the most advanced starting archetypes).
 
[list]
[*] All Curses now exhaust on Discard
[*] Cursewalker no longer has a combo requirement, and card selections are taken from basic movement cards only
[*] Reduced cost to play Apotheosis, Nightmare, and Bone Magic
[*] Remove Combo requirement for playing Crush
[*] Allowed Cursed Weapon to target others
[*] On the other side, we've slightly reduced the Warlock's melee damage to stop them being a magic casting brawler.
[*] Made "Channel" free to use.
[*] Fix for Cursed Lightning and Cursed Strike adding a curse before Damage is done, potentially alternating damage amount
[/list]

[h2]Consumable Changes[/h2]

Consumables haven't quite landed where we intended them to in the overall meta of the game. While they appear commonly, they aren't favourites amongst players, so we've increased (in some cases dramatically) the potency of these single-use items. The idea is that they can get you out of a scrape or turn the tide of a fight, they weren't previously doing that so we'll be interested to see whether we've made enough of a difference with these changes.

[h2]Demon Changes[/h2]

We've made some small changes to the Demons, as we're aware that they have been a bit of a difficulty spike for some players, and while we haven't finished with them yet, we have made some initial changes:

[list]
[*] Demons shouldn't appear so early in Daily Play and Endless Mode
[*] One one of each type of Demon can appear in Daily Play and Endless Mode
[/list]

[h2]Other fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fix false Void tiles on Bridge level
[*] Remove Ouroboros curse, and Bladeturn Tonic from the available curse and Consumables lists, while we investigate their slightly broken behaviours 
[*] Fix for when using Mnemonic multiple times
[*] Fix for Combo threshold cards not showing additional Momentum cost when card momentum is modified by curses etc.
[*] Made it possible to Counter the Skeleton Mage's Lightning Strike
[*] Prevented Demons from appearing so early in Daily Play and Endless mode, and made it so only one type of each demon can spawn in a level
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938141/43c792ba8b4fd69a608f3c346f55d80137d2b00e.png[/img]

Greetings, Knights, and welcome to another round of game updates:

[h2]Gameplay Changes[/h2]

A number of changes have been made to the Hunter Archetype to make it a more valid early-game choice:

[list]
[*] Quick shot has been replaced with Retreating Shot to offer more flexible movement options
[*] Vault has been replaced with Swap to allow the Hunter to free themselves up under more circumstances
[*] Quick shot and its Upgrade have been given more basic damage
[*] Short bow adds two upgraded Quick Shots rather than four regular Quick Shots
[*] Heavy Arrow can now be used on adjacent targets (i.e. 1+ range)
[/list]

Also: 
[list]
[*] Poison/Bleeding no longer trigger interruptible enemies leading to a stun-lock situation
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fix for bonus push actions being added to abilities that down entities
[*] Auto-attack are no longer prevented by counter attacks
[*] Counter-attacks are no longer prevented by forced attacks (i.e Taunts)
[*] Fix for super-niche issue where the Scythe's support attack is used on allies when the enemy is thrown within spinning attack's range
[*] Fix for issues when everyone dies during a Magical Storm
[*] Fix for issues when dying Demons apply curses
[/list]

notes.title: The road ahead...
notes.content:
Dear Knights,

Thank you all so much for playing Knights in Tight Spaces. Whether you're new the franchise or have stuck with us since Fights in Tight Spaces, we are hugely grateful that you've picked up the game amidst so many other amazing titles that are out there clamouring for your time.

We also appreciate hugely the amazing feedback that you've been providing - as you'll have seen from our updates - we take all your feedback very seriously and hope that we've been able to address some of the issues that you've been having, but also make some of the improvements that you've been asking for. New players of the game will already be benefiting from the feedback that you've given and the changes we have made, and we will continue to update it to ensure that it offers the best possible ...Tight Spaces experience you could want.

And because of that, we wanted to take this opportunity to let you know some of our plans over the next couple of months:

[h1]Knights in Tight Spaces - Update Roadmap[/h1]

[h2]Ongoing[/h2]
[list]
[*] Continue to address edge-case stability issues
[*] Gameplay and text tweaks
[*] Resolving quality of life issues
[/list]

[h2]April[/h2]
[list]
[*] Starter deck improvements for Hunter
[*] Curse card balancing and Warlock ability improvements
[*] Equipment balance pass
[*] More clarity and consistency in player and enemy status effects
[*] Enemy Balance pass (particularly the Demon encounter and enemies along The Eleven branch)
[/list]

[h2]May[/h2]
[list]
[*] Equipment system improvements
[*] Removing/selling weapons and equipment
[*] More variety in item and equipment rewards
[*] Improved gameplay flow
[*] Shorter runs
[*] Improved quest skip system
[/list]

[h2]Onwards[/h2]
[list]
[*] UI Improvements, more Accessibility options
[/list]

And - of course - we will continue to listen to our players here on Steam, and in our Discord community, and look to address other issues raised.

Thanks
Ground Shatter

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938141/eef2e121035815f0e40870515779f7a11b38ef6e.png[/img]

Greetings Knights, another update for you, and this one contains one of the most requested improvements: namely that ALL push attacks will count towards push-out objectives, even when the target has been killed as part of the attack.
 
We've also made party play more powerful. Previously there were restrictions on the number of support attacks that could be triggered by a single attack, and this has now been unshackled, so each supporting party member is able to make a Support Attack if they can. This means that Split Kicks, Twin Arrows, Sweeps, Rends, etc. all become massive force multipliers if your squad is lined up correctly.
 
Alongside these headline changes, there's a bunch of smaller fixes and improvements; and over the next couple of weeks we'll be making some changes to some of the Archetypes that have been underperforming; and talking of performance, thanks to our friends at Unity, the next patch will bring some major framerate optimisations for players on certain hardware.

[h3]Gameplay Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Push objectives are now credited to the player, even if the attack kills the target
[*] Support Attacks now fire more consistently and multiple support attacks can fire from a single initial attack (i.e. Sweep)
[*] Consumable cards can no longer be Removed/Discarded by other abilities
[*] Steel self no longer stacks multiplier
[*] Dodge Counter no longer removes other dodge stacks
[*] Additional status icons (Auto-Attack, Turn-to-Face, and Advance) added to overhead panel
[/list]

[h3]Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fix for Poison Strike doesn't apply Poison to all targets
[*] Missing Warlock ability vfx added
[*] Fix for occasional soft lock when cards were removed at the same time as a Combo reduction status was in play
[*] Fix for softlock when Demons arrive at the end of Survival mission in Endless Mode
[*] Fix for occasional soft lock when multiple characters die during Hurricane push
[*] Fix for occasional soft lock when an enemy dies within range of another enemy's sweep
[*] Music tracks correctly assigned within The Eleven Quest
[/list]

notes.title: Build Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938141/41c9672fa76a3292ec934f7a9b9e8af11ddccfa1.png[/img]

Greetings, fellow Knights!

A new patch is here! This time we address some of your most recent QoL and accessibility concerns, along with some fixes, hoping to keep improving and polishing your KITS experience:

[h1]New Features[/h1]

Once you have completed each main quest you will gain the option to start the game from that most recent quest (this will happen via a new conversation when you start a new game)
 
[list]
[*] This won't apply retrospectively, so progress will only be tracked from your next run (or when you complete a quest in your current run if you have one in progress)
[*] [b]Because you are starting the game at a later point, you will miss out on recruits/rewards/upgrades that you would have gained from playing through from the start and parts of the game may become more difficult[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Hostage Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Hostages now spawn closer to the player party, where possible
[*] Player characters and hostages will avoid spawning adjacent to voids and edges
[*] Hostage damage limits have been relaxed for secondary objectives
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]

[list]
[*] You can now speed up animations by holding Space Bar/L3 - [i]this is an unsupported feature and may cause visual glitches[/i]
[*] You can end a run while still gaining the associated experience by using the Abandon Run button on the pause menu
[/list]

[h1]Accessibility[/h1]
New options for extra in-game visual clarity - these can be found in the Accessibility panel on the Options Screen:
[list]
[*] Black and white backdrops
[*] Extra visible player indicator
[*] Scalable card description panel
[*] Ability to disable screen/camera shake
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Enemies that can't be pushed are now shown correct in the Entity Panel
[*] Prevent softlock when trying to Pull an obelisk
[*] Change Recurve Bow Upgrade to use Aimed Shot Upgrade not Bullseye
[*] Prevent Daily Play deck generation picking from inappropriate starter decks
[*] 540 Kick now shows targeting sweep correctly
[*] Fix for softlock when pushing enemy on downed enemy
[/list]

[h1]Text Corrections[/h1]

[list]
[*] Make Yew Bow description accurately reflect behaviour
[*] Make clear that Holy Water applies to all party members
[*] Make Pinning Shot behaviour more clear
[*] Make clear that One Two Punch duplicates a random attack card
[*] Fix Support Damage modifier numbers
[*] Fix some untranslated credits
[/list]

As usual, we want to keep hearing from you! Don't hesitate to share your feedback; and if you have any specific question for our devs, we have [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2315400/discussions/0/612031852355549526/][b]a post in our forums[/b][/url] where you can chat directly with James Parker, our Game Director.

If you have any further queries or need some technical support, you can reach out to the help desk directly to get a fast and thorough response: https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1



[i]- Ground Shatter/Raw Fury[/i]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938141/6f4b7b85342b2c0b2f12bb097bbe0714edaec205.png[/img]

Salutations one and all, 

Can you believe it's been one week since we launched KITS into the big bad world?! We want to thank every single one of our players who have invested their time and energy into supporting our game and our little studio. There has been so much feedback, reviews and strategies in circulation since we hit the launch button here on Steam and we want to express our gratitude to each and every one of you. 

We've released several patches and a hotfix over the past 7 days to address your most pressing concerns. Our goal now is to shift from crisis response—focusing on crashes and softlocks—toward improving quality of life and fixing those lingering, annoying bugs.

We also want to update you on a few key factors related to how and when we intend to patch. 

Ideally we'll be able to push patches each week until we hit a point of stability and balance. We'll be aiming for a mid week deployment for these patches so that we can build, test, push and respond to feedback and issues, while also taking much needed downtime over the weekends.  Here's some other keypoints: 

[list]
[*] A weekly patch allows our team to plan more effectively.
[*] It creates a defined window for our players to expect an update
[*] It allows meaningful time for Quality to asses the changes and flag peripheral issues
[*] Gives players an opportunity to provide feedback on gameplay changes
[/list]

For now this is the plan, although, in the world for software development, especially in games, this is open to change as we navigate the issues we're facing, and those yet to present themselves. 

With that in mind here's the list of the QoL and Bug Fixes we have in patch 1.0.4.

[list]
[*] [b]QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENTS[/b]

[*] massive improvements to Deck Draft when using more specialized starting archetypes
[*] enemies now take account of outcome of poison/bleeding attacks when selecting targets
[*] enemies no longer sometimes turn to face the wall at the end of movement

[*] [b]BUG FIXES[/b]

[*] added missing proper upgrade for Mystic Push
[*] fixed rare softlock in the "The Past Catches Up" sidequest
[*] added missing animation/fixed Preparation
[*] removed non-working "Enable Hotkeys" option from Options Screen
[*] fixed occasional softlock when trapped enemies turn to face targets
[*] fixed negative damage values dealing damage
[*] fixed softlock on Trader Screen when the player has close to the maximum number of cards in their deck
[*] corrections to some sword weapon pivot points and hold angles
[*] prevented Eleven-related side quests appearing on a specific story branch 
[*] fixed leaderboards being capped at 10 entries
[*] fixed the description values on Finessed Halberd+
[/list]


That's all for now folks, but if you have any further queries or need some technical support, I recommend reaching out to the help desk directly to get a fast and thorough response. It's also more convenience to share save files and crash logs with us there. Hit the link below to create ticket.

[b]Your save folder is here:[/b]
C:\Users\YOURUSERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\Raw Fury\Knights in Tight Spaces

[b]Your crash folder is here:[/b]
C:/Users/YOURUSERNAME/AppData/Local/Temp/Raw Fury/Knights in Tight Spaces/Crashes
[b]
And you can submit it to us here:[/b]
https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1



Once again, a huge thank you from our entire team! Your encouragement and support mean the world to us and to KITS.



Ground Shatter/Raw Fury

notes.title: Hotfix Update - Teleport
notes.content:
Hello all you weekend warriors,

Quick update, we’ve just pushed a hotfix to address the teleport bug some of you were experiencing. Thanks to the detailed player reports (and the save files you shared), we were able to track down the issue and get it fixed last night.

We’re still hard at work on bigger patches and updates, but we also want to tackle those immediate frustrations as fast as we can.

This is the single hotfix note, marvel at it's glory:


[b][olist]
[*] Fix issue where some players were experiencing a soft lock when teleport abilities are used
[/olist][/b]

Huge thanks for all the amazing support this week,  we truly appreciate it and we'll be back cracking skulls and crushing bugs next week. Well, crushing bugs at least. 

Hope you all have a fantastic weekend and enjoy the game!

[b]
Ground Shatter/Raw Fury[/b]

notes.title: End of Week One
notes.content:
First of all, thank you so much for such an amazing response. The whole team at Ground Shatter and everyone at Raw Fury has been blown away by how many of you have engaged with Knights in Tight Spaces. We’ve tried to stay on top of your reviews, your discussion threads, your Discord posts and your social media - we value all of your comments (good and bad) and are digesting them all.

It’s only been 3 days but it feels like about three months, we’ve worked hard to patch some crashes that a small sub-set of the audience were experiencing, we’ve addressed some edge-case soft-locks, we’ve made a positive change to the audio mix to ensure that the hits feel a lot more solid, and we’ve made a few balance changes that didn’t quite make it in for launch. In a game as large and system-based as KITS, there’s always going to be some things that slip through the cracks, so we’re grateful for your patience on those.

I figured that it would be a good opportunity to let you know which areas of the game we’re going to look at over the next couple of weeks - largely based on the feedback that we’ve already received but also to improve the game in ways that we have identified internally.

[list]
[*] [b]We want to allow players to skip forward in the story[/b] - we’re aware that playing the Prologue over and over is slowing you up getting to the good stuff, so we’ll be adding in options to give you more variety in how you start Story Mode.

[*] [b]We’ve heard you on Deck Draft issues[/b] - we know that this is an important way to play the game for a lot of you and it could do with more love to make more varied builds possible.

[*] [b]Balance issues[/b] - we are aware that some of the objectives can be a little tricky, so they are due a pass as well; longer term we want to add more variety into the objectives as well with some new ideas that came too late for launch.

[*] [b]Quality of Life and Accessibility.[/b] We’ve had some really good suggestions about how we can improve the game for people with specific needs, and we’ll try to implement those in meaningful ways as we go forward.
[/list]

You may see more small hotfixes patches in the mean time if they are needed, but some of the wider changes will come in larger updates (as we will need to ensure they are tested thoroughly before unleashing them on you). Thanks again!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44938141/34b98529939ce6b23f67eaa9bf26513beccd5497.png[/img]


Hello world!


It's Friday, and because it's Friday the team is going to be taking a well earned break for the weekend after the day is done. But before we down-tools, we wanted to push one more patch your way.

Today we're addressing a very troublesome XP-gains bug that some players have been pointing out in the forums. We had a workaround, but now we have a fix.

On top of that we wanted to introduce a quality of life improvement to the audio profile in KITS. We have seen your feedback in the threads, heard the things that were bothering you and made some alterations with that in mind. 


Onward to the notes:

[list]
[*] fixed issues that some players on controller/Steam Deck were having having where XP was not awarded at the end of a run
[/list]

In response to feedback, the in-fight audio-mix has been improved:

[list]
[*] slightly quieter music during fights
[*] heavier/punchier/louder impact sounds
[*] louder character audio overall
[/list]


We're also looking into the softlocks that players are reporting. This is a troublesome area and it would greatly speed up the debug process if we could take save files from players which are having the issue [i]immediately[/i] after the softlock occurs. We'd need the save file [u]before[/u] you start a new run though, as a new run would overwrite the file and make it useless for review. 


If you are one such player, and you had the time to help us track this, you could make a ticket and attach your save log :

Your save folder is here:
C:\Users\YOURUSERNAME\AppData\LocalLow\Raw Fury\Knights in Tight Spaces

Your crash folder is here:
C:/Users/YOURUSERNAME/AppData/Local/Temp/Raw Fury/Knights in Tight Spaces/Crashes

And you can submit it to us here:
https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1

We're being cautious with these smaller updates as we're trying to manage the extremely tight testing time we have between patches. We run QA in these one-day windows which is there to make sure we don't break anything when trying to apply these improvements. 


I'll still be around the forums over the weekend, keeping track of the issues and feedback you are sharing with us so please keep it coming, especially the positive reviews as we try to reach more players. We're also reading through negative reviews and where possible, letting you know we've addressed your grievances. 


Once again from all the team here, thank you thank you thank you!
You're encouragement and support means everything to us and to KITS.


[b]
Ground Shatter/Raw Fury[/b]

Folks, you have been experiencing crashes and we've been trying our best to figure out what the hell is causing them. In almost all cases it appears to be something related to the engine, rather than lets say a missing call out in our game logic. With that in mind we've been running a test on a Unity engine update which we're hoping is going to crush this problem, and ideally not cause any new ones. 

Speed and accuracy are both priorities so this is a small patch for now:

[list]
[*] Engine update to resolve random crashes
[*] Fixed Softlock that would sometimes manifest at the beginning of the Golem fight
[/list]



One more thing I would like to mention is that we have a fix related to a brutal XP bug, however it is not going to be in this patch, but rather our next one, which could be tomorrow. The note will be:

[list]
[*] Fixed issue in relation to XP gains not being recorded
[/list]

While it's not in this build I feel the need mention it now as it's coming along immediately after this patch so please hang in there if you're experiencing it. 



That's all for now so in the meantime if you want to join our Discord for more fluid conversation you can do so over here: https://discord.gg/fights-in-tight-spaces-593465873575051317

I'll be heading back to the forums right now to keep reading and sorting through your various impressions and reports so I'll see you there!

In the meantime if you want to join our Discord for more fluid conversation you can do so over here: [b]https://discord.gg/fights-in-tight-spaces-593465873575051317[/b]

[b]https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1[/b]


From the entire team at Ground Shatter and Raw Fury, thank you so much for joining us in our opening hours. Your support is absolutely monumental right now and it's been so motivating to read your reviews and to hear your thoughts. Keep 'em coming!

Thank you <3

GS/RF

notes.title: Knights in Tight Spaces Is Out Now!
notes.content:
Finally, the doors are open. Arm yourself and sharpen your wits: It’s time to get medieval.
 
[b]Welcome to Knights in Tight Spaces! [/b]

[previewyoutube=6kGiZQrj8aE;full][/previewyoutube]

We are eager to read about your tactics, combos and tips, so come to our [b][url=https://discord.gg/fights-in-tight-spaces-593465873575051317]Discord[/url][/b] server and join the Games in Tight Spaces community. What’s your favorite character? Have you discovered any cool team strategy you want to share?

And if you want to deep-dive into our worldbuilding, remember you can also get the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3301150/Knights_in_Tight_Spaces__Official_Game_Soundtrack]OST[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3528290/Knights_in_Tight_Spaces__Artbook]an artbook with exclusive developer commentary[/url]. [/b]

[h2]Key features in Knights in Tight Spaces[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]A stylish, action-packed take on deckbuilders[/b] - Fight through challenging scenarios packed with enemies, with strong action-movie visual effects and animations, while vibing with the electronic soundtrack.
[*] [b]Master your surroundings[/b] - Position carefully around enemies and obstacles, making sure to keep your tactical advantage. 
[*] [b]Gather your party and unveil secrets[/b] - Recruit characters and assemble a party to add a new layer of strategic thinking to your runs
[*] [b]Find your playstyle[/b] - With 300 cards, different classes and gear to equip, and an upgrade system, Knights in Tight Spaces offers countless hours of deckbuilding fun
[/list]
